title: GPM IMERG Final Precipitation, daily 0.1° (V07)
description: NASA's Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals for GPM (IMERG) combines precipitation estimates from an international satellite constellation, calibrated against the GPM Core Observatory and, in the Final run, monthly gauge analyses. This record covers the daily 0.1° Final product (GPM_3IMERGDF V07).
purpose: Satellite precipitation at daily scale for monitoring rainfall events, seasonal accumulation and drought onset across Algeria, including areas with few rain gauges.

spatial_extent.description: Global grid (complete coverage between 60°N and 60°S). Algeria lies fully within the grid; users must subset it.

temporal_extent.description: V07 Final run from 1998. NASA CMR listed data through 30 Sep 2025 when checked; the Final run is released several months after observation. The AEO map shows NASA GIBS near-real-time IMERG visualisations, which are not the Final run.

variables.name: precipitation
variables.description: Daily accumulated multi-satellite precipitation (gauge-adjusted in the Final run)

processing: Passive-microwave precipitation retrievals from constellation satellites are intercalibrated to the GPM Core Observatory, propagated and merged with infrared estimates, then (Final run) adjusted with monthly gauge analyses. Daily files aggregate the half-hourly estimates.
limitations: Satellite estimate, not a gauge measurement; light rainfall, orographic precipitation over the Tell Atlas and coastal ranges, and snowfall are less reliable.
Gauge adjustment depends on the density of reporting stations, which is low across the Algerian Sahara.
0.1° cells average over strong local rainfall gradients in northern Algeria.

access.label: Access at source (GES DISC)
access.notes: NASA Earthdata Login required to download.

algeria_notes: Useful for event-scale rainfall and season-to-date totals over the northern cereal belt. Compare against CHIRPS and station data before drawing conclusions for specific wilayas.
